text:
People living in the Greater Manchester constituency of Makerfield will soon head to the polls to elect their new MP.

The by-election was triggered by Labour MP Josh Simons standing down.

It will be held on Thursday 18 June, with the result expected to be announced in the early hours of Friday morning.

We asked each candidate to create a short video about why they were standing.

You can see them each below in alphabetical order by candidate surname.
